## LoadHostGovernanceOptions interface

Overrides for where [loadHostGovernance()](./runtime.loadhostgovernance.md) reads and writes. Each defaults to its location under `MACTS_HOME`<!-- -->; overriding is for tests and custom installs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface LoadHostGovernanceOptions
```
